title: Renewal of Science Conference 2024 in the Bay Area, California
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
I and a group of folks interested in RS and alternative science are trying to get all the alternative scientists together (some even from the mainstream) in order to give the public a taste of what it is like to think differently in the fundamental sciences. Please take a look here:

https://www.renewalofculture.org/renewalofscience

Dates: October 31 - November 2, 2024.
Location: Mountain View, CA.

I'll be covering the Larson part, taking a start from his identification of heat as being half-effective outwardly.

Would love to have all folks interested in the RS to come to this (PM me for discount details). We can finally kick off a reboot of the RS, in a way that should create a real impact.

Thank you for keeping up the fight Gopi. I can't go, but I'll be watching that page for any videos posted afterwards.
After watching the Terrance Howard kerfuffle, I was very impressed at how Eric Weinstein treated and respected him. I wonder if Eric would be a possible speaker or at least also be open to the idea of RS2?

I'm glad this forum is seeing activity again.
